CustomField.description: Which partner organization's rep was involved in this opportunity, if any. "None" means no partner rep was involved. Intentionally name-agnostic (not Straumann-specific) so any current or future partnership can be tracked - see OPS-286. Defaults to "None" rather than true blank because Dynamic Forms visibility rules on a Picklist field require an explicit comparison value - the NE-with-no-rightValue "is not blank" trick used elsewhere on this page (e.g. Eligible_Labs__c) only works for text/lookup/multiselect fields, not single-select Picklist.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave as None if no partner rep was involved.
CustomField.label: Partner Rep Org
